# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the tasks you measurably broke/fixed, plus the ones whose move was too small to resolve) right below your entry. Do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (and which LEVER to switch to):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration 1: Initial Capability Creation
- Created `prompt.md`: Added explicit rules against writing formulas, a mandatory verification checklist, and a worked example for literal value writing.
- Created `task_template.md`: Integrated literal value requirements and full range coverage as core constraints.
- EXPECTED effect: Fixes the "Formula instead of Value" cluster (37378, 46897) and "Incomplete/Empty Range" cluster (227-40, 48527, 50768).
- SAFE: All edits are additive rules or structural constraints that align with passing tasks (which already write literals and fill ranges).
- Prior RESULTS: N/A (First iteration).
- High-value clusters remaining: Precise value calculation for complex logic tasks.

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.675 Δ=+0.225 · fixed={37378, 37456, 46897, 51-12, 53383, 54144, 55049, 55979, 56563, 6698, 7902, 80-42, 8942} · broke={395-36, 402-43, 416-15, 560-12} · unresolved={—} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — not evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them).
<!-- cand_0001: ACCEPTED val=0.675 Δ=+0.225 -->

## Iteration cand_0002 — Fix Range Mismatches, Color Detection, and Hardcoded Indices
- Changes I made:
  - prompt.md: Added dynamic range detection to Inspect step (targets 9569).
  - prompt.md: Added Cross-Check to Verify step to compare written cells with literal instructions (targets 560-12).
  - prompt.md: Added Technical Guidance for robust color detection (targets 267-18).
  - task_template.md: Added constraint against truncating data to fit answer range (targets 402-43, 227-40).
- EXPECTED effect: Fixes range-related mismatch and truncation errors, improves color detection, and eliminates hardcoded range assumptions. Safe because passing tasks already do not truncate, detect colors correctly (or don't need to), and use dynamic ranges.
- Building on prior RESULTS: Built on cand_0001's literal value and verification constraints.
- Refuted hypotheses: None this iteration.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: Complex logic failures in specific tasks.
- Plateau signal: N/A.
- Focus next iteration: Further refine logic and interpretation for the remaining failures.

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** REJECTED (champion unchanged) · val=0.650 Δ=-0.025 · fixed={39046, 416-15, 9569} · broke={37456, 51-12, 59595, 80-42} · unresolved={—} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — not evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them). — its WHOLE batch was reverted; re-introduce only the edits that did NOT break a task above, dropping/redesigning the ones that did.
<!-- cand_0002: rejected val=0.650 Δ=-0.025 -->

## Iteration cand_0003 — Force Explicit Verification and Refine Answer Placement
- Changes I made:
  - prompt.md: Modified Verify step to mandate `print()` statements for all answer range values. (targets Verification Gap)
  - task_template.md: Modified Completion Criteria to require explicit printing of final values. (targets Verification Gap)
  - prompt.md: Added Technical Guidance on interpreting "put from X" and handling single-value results in a range. (targets Answer Placement Errors)
- EXPECTED effect: Fixes failures where the agent narrates verification but does not actually perform it in code (e.g. 560-12, 39046, 416-15). Safe because passing tasks already produce correct values; making them print them does not change the result.
- Building on prior RESULTS: Built on cand_0001's baseline. Avoided the specific "Cross-Check" and "Color Detection" logic from cand_0002 as it coincided with a regression in tasks 37456, 51-12, 59595, 80-42.
- Refuted hypotheses: None this iteration.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: Deep logic failures in specific complex tasks.
- Plateau signal: N/A.
- Focus next iteration: Analyze remaining failures after the structural verification is enforced.
